{{Quote|I know Darvannis. One of the first worlds we conquered when the war started--a staging point into the wider galaxy.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="KotFE 14">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=14}}</ref>}}
The '''Invasion of Darvannis''' occurred in the early stage of the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of the known galaxy. Of little interest to both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Darvannis was only defended by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] forces hired by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. The [[Eternal Fleet]] easily drove them away and claimed the planet for [[Eternal Empire]]. A [[Darvannis factory|factory]] was constructed on world that produced ships, weapons and [[Skytrooper]] droid forces for the Eternal Empire.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Invasion of Darvannis is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in the codex entry obtained during '''Chapter 14: Mandalore the Avenger'''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
